test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Smriti Mandhana became the most expensive player in the Women's Indian Premier League with the 3.4 crore bid by ______ in 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Royal Challengers Bangalore.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Royal Challengers Bangalore **bid** 3.4 crore** for **Smriti Mandhana** in the** Women's Indian Premier League** in** 2023.**
 
• Smriti Mandhana is a **left-handed opening batter **who has represented India in all formats of the game and has been a consistent performer for the country.
 
• The **Women's Indian Premier League** (WIPL) is a professional **Twenty20 cricket league** for women in India, which was announced in 2020 and is expected to start in 2023.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Board of Control for Cricket in India is the organization that organized the 2023 Women's Premier League.
 
• **Five teams **competed in the tournament, which took place from **March 4–26, 2023.**
 
• Mumbai Indians won the competition by **defeating Delhi Capitals** in the final.
